versions.text: Criterion: Verify that lateral-directional flying qualities have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.3 Lateral-directional flying qualities. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets the standards for lateral-directional flying qualities within ADS-33-PRF. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, simulation, and inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
